በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
ለውእቱ: ውእቱ — of that, that (ለ- 'of, to' + demonstrative ውእቱ before a noun: ለውእቱ መጽሐፍ 'of that book')
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
አውየዉ: አውየወ — they cried out, wailed (3mp perfect; related to the noun አውያት 'wailing') (?)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ዘብርት: ብርት — of/which (ዘ- + ብርት); the word is unidentified, perhaps 'bronze' (cf. ch. 9–12) so 'of bronze' (?)
ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
ነጽሮ: ነጸረ — looking, to look (verbal noun/infinitive ነጽሮ of ነጸረ)
ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
ወአምኑ: አምነ — and they believed (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, ʾ-m-n)
ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ወኢአምኑ: አምነ — and they did not believe (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G)
በሲኦል: ሲኦል — as Sheol, by Sheol (በ- 'as, by means of' + proper noun)
ወሰምዑ: ሰምዐ — and they heard (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
ምድረ: ምድር — earth, land (noun, construct state 'land-of') · accusative 'a land', 'the ground' (ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land'; እከሪ ምድረ 'I dig the ground')
ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ወዘከመሂ: ዘከመ — and however, in whatever way (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ 'as, how' + enclitic -ሂ)
ለክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ, Christ's (ለ- naming the possessor after an anticipating suffix) · ለ- marking the object, doubled by the suffix on ወያመስልዎ ('they liken Christ')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice')
ናየድዐክሙ: አየድዐ — we shall inform you (1cp imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of y-d-ʿ + -ክሙ '2mp you') (?)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ማእመሬ: ማእመር — knower of (agent noun of አእመረ 'know'; construct; ማእመሬ አልባብ 'knower of hearts')
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
ወእሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — and they, indeed (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሰ)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ይምጽኡ: መጽአ — that they come (3mpl subjunctive, after ከመ)
ወበሎሙ: ብህለ — and say to them (ወ- + imperative በል of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ሙ 'them')
ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
ዘአነ: አነ — what I (ዘ- 'that which' + pronoun አነ 'I')
ወይግበሩ: ገብረ — and they shall make (ወ- + 3mp jussive/imperfect)
ትእዛዝየ: ትእዛዝ — commandment (noun, singular, possibly collective; from አዘዘ; + -የ 'my', 1cs)
ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
በሣልስት: ሣልስ — on the third (በ- + ordinal ሣልስ, fem. ሣልስት, agreeing with ዕለት)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
አእሩገ: አረጋዊ — elder, old man (plural አእሩግ (?); construct 'elders-of')
ወወፅኡ: ወጽአ — and they came out (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
ቦሙ: በ — by them, in them (preposition በ- + -ሙ '3mp', ቦሙ)
ወድንጋፄ: ድንጋፄ — and dismay, terror (ወ- + noun; also spelled ድንጋጼ)
ወዕንዚራ: ዕንዚራ — and ዕንዚራ (?) (ወ- + noun; a stringed instrument, perhaps a harp or lyre) (?)
ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
ወፅአ: ወጽአ — he came out (3ms perfect, G; written ወፅአ)
ይቤልዎ: ብህለ — they said to him (3mp perf. ይቤሉ + ሎ 'to him', written ይቤልዎ)
ለዛቲ: ዛቲ — to this, of this (ለ- + fem. demonstrative ዛቲ before ትውልድ)
ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
አፈ: አፍ — mouth of (noun, construct state; አፈ እግዚኣብሔር 'mouth of God')
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel') · accusative in apposition to መንታ: ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples' (the twins as heads of lines) (?) · or construct 'the two peoples of Perez and Zerah' (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ ፋሬስ ወዛራ) (?)
ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
ዘእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — whom God (made king, etc.) (ዘ- 'the one whom' + noun as subject of the following verb; ዘእግዚኣብሔር አንገሠ 'whom God made king') · 'of God', ዘ- as genitive marker after a noun (ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the church of God')
ወአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
ዘይክል: ከሀለ — who is able (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
ወየሐዩ: ሐይወ — and they shall live (ወ- + 3mp imperfect)
ወትሬኢ: ርእየ — and she sees (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G)
ምስብዒተ: ምስብዒት — sevenfold, seven times (?) (noun from ሰብዐ 'seven', accusative, adverbial) (?)
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ኢይክሉ: ከሀለ — they cannot (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G 'be able')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
ይትዐወቅ: ተዐወቀ — it is known (3ms imperfect, passive tG-stem of ዐወቀ)
ሰሚዐ: ሰምዐ — to hear, hearing (infinitive, G; infinitive absolute before ሰማዕከ, 'truly hear')
